messages:
elaine-cs: Heads-up — GarnetPay just told us they're rolling a new org-wide realtime fraud project that uses embeddings + scoring. They spun up 3 product squads this week and our telemetry shows ~4x QPS since Tue across generate + embed endpoints. Could be a big expansion signal but also a capacity/risk flag.

jonah-sales: Nice signal. Do we have a breakdown (committed vs overage)? cc @siti-pm

siti-pm: Great catch — if they're going realtime scoring we should push for a short dedicated pilot (predictable latency + cost). Any obvious latency SLO breaches or error spikes?

elaine-cs: Quick console snapshot: committed tokens: 300k/day -> current ~1.3M/day; embeddings 120k/day -> ~700k/day. p95 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west ~240ms and holding, but 502s rose to 0.4% in last 24h. Logs snippet for QPS trend: 
```
# from metrics api
GET /api/metrics?account=GarnetPay&range=24h
qps_generate: 4200 req/min (peak 6100)
qps_embed: 1800 req/min (peak 2500)
```

devon-ops: I can provision a short-term dedicated pool in EU (2x nodes) to stabilize them for a week while we scope a pilot. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching + slightly larger batch window — should cut token cost and smooth p95. Need approval for infra + billing change.

jonah-sales: tagging account owner @marco-am — Marco, is sales open to coupling a pilot w/ a commit uplift? This looks like lateral expansion into risk/fraud.

onboard-bot: Ticket #CS-9281 created: "GarnetPay realtime fraud pilot" — assigned to devon-ops, priority: high. ETA: infra provision 24h, pilot rollout 72h.

marco-am: Thanks team — I'm in. Proposal: 3-week dedicated pilot + 30% commit uplift to start, then reassess. I'll draft a commercial note. Elaine — can you prepare a short customer brief and usage dashboard for the pricing call?

elaine-cs: On it. One more ask — GarnetPay wants a fallback plan if p95 slips >300ms. Can we provide a short runbook?

devon-ops: I'll draft a runbook + canary plan. Also recommend auto-fallback to a quantized model variant for non-critical calls and an emergency throttle policy to keep tail latencies bounded.

siti-pm: Can we schedule an enablement call with their eng leads tomorrow 10am PT? I'd like to walkthrough SDK best practices for KV caching and batching. I'll send invites.

jonah-sales: +1 — looks like good renewal/expansion upside and strong use-case (reducing false positives). Capture ROI metrics during pilot.

elaine-cs: Summary / action items: (1) Marco — pricing proposal for 3-week pilot + commit uplift; (2) Devon — infra provisioning + runbook + canary; (3) Siti — enablement call + invite; (4) Elaine — CS brief + dashboard and send to GarnetPay leads. Thanks all :thumbsup:
